correctness.rationale: All three nonzero Artin–Schreier characters have odd polynomial degree five and the branch is uniquely infinity. An isomorphism of equipped covers therefore induces an affine map. Unique odd Artin–Schreier reductions give equation (1); leading and cubic coefficient comparisons yield \(a^5=1\) and \(\mu=\lambda a^3\) when nonzero, exactly \(\lambda^5=\mu^5\); translation coefficients give 16, 4, or 1 affine stabilizers multiplied by four deck lifts, hence 960, 16, 4. The direct expansion finite-field checker verified the three parameter regimes; it is corroboration only, not an infinite proof. Full curve automorphism groups are unclaimed.

value.rationale: The specific genus-six family shows that quotient \(a\)-numbers do not determine the cover geometry. The complete geometric cover-moduli invariant \(t=\lambda^5\) gives all isomorphism classes and an exact inertia jump at unique nonzero \(t=1\), within constant nonzero Ekedahl–Oort and \(a\)-number loci. It identifies intrinsic structure of a motivated infinite family, not a small table or tautological coefficient rescaling.
